title: Honor Robot Phone Global Launch: Equipped with Agentic OS and New YOYO Pro, Opening a New Era of Multimodal Intelligence

content_html:
At the global new product launch event of Honor Robot Phone tonight, Honor officially unveiled this highly anticipated new model. As an innovative product focusing on intelligent interaction, the biggest highlight of the Robot Phone is its Agentic OS, the next-generation partner-type multimodal intelligent operating system, and the newly launched YOYO Pro mode, which is deeply powered by Alibaba Qwen's large model. It supports extended task execution, cross-ecosystem collaboration, and other rich features.

In terms of appearance and industrial design, the Honor Robot Phone offers two color options: Star Track Silver and Moon Shadow Gray. The entire machine features a slim body with a thickness of 9.59 mm and a 248g full-metal unibody design. The front is equipped with a 6.31-inch display, offering a delicate touch and excellent visual experience.

For core hardware and battery configuration, the device is powered by the fifth-generation Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 flagship chip, delivering powerful performance. Additionally, the body houses a high-capacity 7060 mAh Qinghai Lake battery, ensuring long-lasting power, and supports a four-microphone array for more accurate voice interaction experiences.

content_html_zh:
在今晚的荣耀机器人手机全球新品发布会上，荣耀正式发布了这款备受期待的新机型。 作为一款专注于智能交互的创新产品，机器人手机最大的亮点在于其新一代伙伴型多模态智能操作系统Agentic OS，以及新推出的YOYO Pro模式，深度搭载阿里巴巴Qwen大机型。 它支持扩展任务执行、跨生态系统协作等丰富功能。

外观和工业设计方面，荣耀机器人手机提供星轨银、月影灰两种配色。 整机机身纤薄，厚度9.59毫米，248克全金属一体式机身设计。 正面配备6.31英寸显示屏，触感细腻，视觉体验极佳。

核心硬件和电池配置上，该机搭载第五代骁龙8代3旗舰芯片，性能强劲。 此外，机身搭载7060mAh大容量青海湖电池，保证持久电量，并支持四麦克风阵列，带来更精准的语音交互体验。
